ALGER — À l'approche de la période estiv: ALGIERS — As the summer period approaches, Mobilis, historic operator of the Algerian market, presents an updated range of international roaming packages. These new offers aim to guarantee customers permanent access to communication services, including calls and mobile data, while traveling outside Algeria.
Les abonnés pourront bénéficier de forfa: Subscribers will be able to benefit from packages starting from 1,000 Algerian dinars, with data volumes of up to 60 gigabytes. Eligible destinations cover several strategic regions: Tunisia, Turkey, China and Europe. Mobilis highlights these solutions to offer a connected, flexible experience adapted to the needs of travelers.
L'opérateur souligne que ces offres s'in: The operator emphasizes that these offers are part of an approach to supporting customers, wherever they are. “These packages allow you to stay in touch with loved ones while benefiting from modern and efficient services,” indicates Mobilis in its press release. Activation terms and pricing details are available via the operator's official channels.
